Pac Resource Validate Pac
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/pacFiles/validate

Sends the PAC file content for validation and returns the validation result. To learn more, see Using Custom PAC Files to Forward Traffic to ZIA.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

PAC file content

string
string
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
success
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether the PAC file validation was successful or not

messages
object[]
warningCount
int32

The number of warnings present in the list of messages

errorCount
int32

The number of errors present in the list of messages
